description: This file defines the API and constants for scripting functionalities in Redis, including script execution context, flags, and control functions.

classes.name: scriptRunCtx
classes.description: Structure representing the context for script execution, including function name, client info, flags, and timing.

methods.name: scriptFlagsToCmdFlags
methods.description: Converts script flags to command flags.

methods.name: scriptPrepareForRun
methods.description: Prepares the script execution context for running a script.

methods.name: scriptSetResp
methods.description: Sets the response type for the script.

methods.name: scriptSetRepl
methods.description: Sets the replication mode for the script.

methods.name: scriptCall
methods.description: Calls a script and handles errors.

methods.name: scriptIsRunning
methods.description: Checks if a script is currently running.

methods.name: scriptCurrFunction
methods.description: Returns the current function name being executed.

methods.name: scriptIsEval
methods.description: Checks if the current script is an eval.

methods.name: scriptIsTimedout
methods.description: Checks if the current script has timed out.

methods.name: scriptGetClient
methods.description: Returns the client associated with the current script.

methods.name: scriptGetCaller
methods.description: Returns the original client that called the script.

methods.name: scriptTimeSnapshot
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the script started.

methods.name: scriptRunDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration the script has been running.
